_comment: Default bindings for the controllers this package declares - one section per machine,
transcribed from BizHawk's Assets/defctrl.json. Only player 1 is bound: a second pad is something you
plug in deliberately. The user's own bindings always win.

Genesis Controller.P1 Up: Up, J1 POV1U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
Genesis Controller.P1 Down: Down, J1 POV1D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
Genesis Controller.P1 Left: Left, J1 POV1L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
Genesis Controller.P1 Right: Right, J1 POV1R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight
